run_Evaluator_evaluate: run the Evaluator evaluate method to compute all model metrics and log results for a given epoch
run_Evaluator_eval_reconstruction_loss: run the Evaluator eval_reconstruction_loss method to compute the autoencoder reconstruction perplexity across all data batches
run_Evaluator_eval_clf_accuracy: run the Evaluator eval_clf_accuracy method to compute flipped attribute accuracy using the trained classifier
run_Evaluator_eval_lat_dis_accuracy: run the Evaluator eval_lat_dis_accuracy method to compute the latent discriminator prediction accuracy per attribute
run_compute_accuracy: run the compute_accuracy function to compute classifier prediction accuracy across all data batches
